hero.name: Leon Elliott Fuller

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science Engineer working as a Junior Security Engineer at Wazuh, specializing in SIEM, XDR, and intrusion detection systems. I graduated in Computer Engineering from the University of Granada with a specialization in Computing and Intelligent Systems.

I am committed to building a strong foundation for my career by continuously developing my skills and embracing new challenges. Currently focused on discipline and learning, I am determined to face complex tasks and put in the hard work.

Throughout my university years, I have worked on projects spanning Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Data Science, Game Development, Cybersecurity, and Web Development. I bring a proactive attitude and a passion for learning.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.description: Interactive 3D visualization of elliptic curves via the Hopf fibration. Explore 18 torus shapes across lattice, wavy, and exotic categories, with 12 color modes, 6 materials, 3 animations, and full custom parameter control. Built with Three.js as part of my thesis on elliptic curve cryptography.

items.title: Running
items.description: I'm a self-proclaimed professional mediocre marathon runner. I love the challenge of long-distance running and often do races, sometimes with friends just for fun.

items.title: Nature & Mountains
items.description: Mountain and nature lover. I enjoy hiking and discovering new landscapes wherever I go. There's nothing like fresh air and a great view to clear your mind.

items.title: Music
items.description: Music is a constant companion - whether I'm coding, running, or just relaxing. I enjoy discovering new genres and artists.

description: Resolved high-impact Wazuh issues for enterprise customers, significantly improving visibility, detection accuracy, and system stability.
Engineered tailored security solutions using SIEM, XDR, HIDS, and NIDS principles across OnPrem and Cloud infrastructures.
Designed and established custom Security Operations Center (SOC) setups for major corporations. Advised on security hardening, anomaly detection tuning, and reduction of false positives.
Worked as an IT Consultant helping workers with their IT issues, partly creating a Desktop App for the company.
Set up the company's 2FA, antimalware, spyware, and phishing rules, and generally maintained the company's IT service.
Provided training sessions for end users on the use of newly implemented technologies or processes.

items.details: Specialized in Computing and Intelligent Systems. Coursework: AI, Machine Learning, Networking, C++, Python, OOP, OpenGL, Cybersecurity. Honors in Calculus, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Programming.
Finishing studies abroad. Coursework: Computer Vision, Deep Learning in Medical Image Analysis, Cybersecurity, Real Time Operating Systems in C, and Cloud Computing.

items.name: Cypher - Encrypted Chat App
items.description: State-of-the-art encrypted chat application with end-to-end encryption, real-time messaging, zero metadata storage, and advanced protocols like TLS and Signal. Features AES encryption and complete anonymity.

items.name: Self-Hosted Nextcloud
items.description: Private, self-hosted alternative to Google Drive using Docker and Traefik. Part of a broader homelab setup focused on data privacy and complete control over personal files.

items.name: Pichola - Award-Winning Game
items.description: Award-winning game created during a 48-hour Game Jam using Godot Engine. Theme: 'Start from Nothing'. Players begin as an egg, collecting others to unlock abilities. Won 'Best Art'.

items.name: AI for Ludo Game
items.description: A reimagined Parchís game with a strategic twist, featuring a deliberative AI agent using MINIMAX and ALPHA-BETA PRUNING for intelligent gameplay against human players.

items.name: Visual Path Finding
items.description: Interactive visualization tool demonstrating path-finding algorithms like A*, Dijkstra, and more. An educational resource for understanding algorithmic mechanics.

items.name: Classifying Mushrooms
items.description: Mushroom edibility classification using supervised ML models. Analyzed the UCI Secondary Mushroom dataset as part of the ML course at the University of Granada.

items.name: Solar System Simulation
items.description: Python-based simulation of a solar system with gravitational pull, collision dynamics, and asteroid interactions. Built with pygame.

items.name: Elliptic Curve Visualization
items.description: Interactive visualization of elliptic curves (y² = x³ + ax + b) with adjustable parameters and zoom. Built as part of my thesis work on elliptic curve cryptography.
